key_insight: A steering agent can monitor LLM agent execution in real time and intervene only when needed to correct goal drift in single-agent and multi-agent workflows.
engineering_relevance: This enables more reliable and efficient tool-using AI systems by reducing wasted steps, improving task success, and allowing controllable supervision overhead.
method: Observe execution context during long-horizon agent runs.
Use a fast path to decide when to intervene and a slow path to choose how to intervene.
Train both paths jointly with reinforcement learning using pairwise ranking plus GRPO.
evidence_signal: Experiments on information-seeking search tasks show improved performance and efficiency, with generalization to out-of-domain tasks and unseen executors.
watch_item: The approach adds an extra supervisory model and training complexity, so latency and deployment cost must be managed carefully in real systems.
paper_title: Learning to Steer LLM Agents and Multi-Agent Systems
